gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau-infant: Bruno Ace SC spaces its open-mouthed capitals out like beads on a thread, with no thinning anywhere in the stroke. Ysabeau Infant follows with friendly sans letters whose terminals flick outward, a softer hand that keeps the heading from feeling cold.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau-office: Letters strung out like beads on a long thread make Bruno Ace SC instantly recognizable, and none of its strokes thin out. Ysabeau Office takes over in sans-serif with curves left open at the ends, a modern, quieter counterpart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau-sc: Wide, beaded, and bold in attitude, Bruno Ace SC holds its crossbars at the same thickness as its stems. Yet Ysabeau SC, a plain sans with a visibly gaping c, does best when you give it a little extra size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zalando-sans: Expressive from the first glance, Bruno Ace SC looks cut from strips of equal width, each letter spaced out on its thread. Zalando Sans reads smoothly, its open curves carrying a longer passage without a snag.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zalando-sans-expa: Distinctive in every glyph, Bruno Ace SC keeps its line width constant through each turn, letters spread out like beads on a thread. Zalando Sans Expanded feels clean and sparse beside it, wide gaps echoing that spacing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Bruno Ace SC looks like letters bent from one length of wire, spaced out like beads on a long thread. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded then brings open-mouthed curves in sans-serif, a modern counterweight with real polish.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Wire-bright and wide, Bruno Ace SC never shifts from heavy to light within a stroke. ZCOOL XiaoWei, a plain sans with gentle hairlines, would feel strained if the heading shrank or the body grew large.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-a: Bruno Ace SC is a display face with open apertures and letters strung out like beads on a thread. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique gives the sans-serif text a t with matching crossbar and stem, and it prefers a modest size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-n: Beaded letters, open and wide. Bruno Ace SC announces the page with expressive display shapes, while Zen Kaku Gothic New, a sans with no hairlines and no swells, keeps the text beneath it approachable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Bruno Ace SC excels at making a bold, widely spaced statement, with open apertures and no thinning strokes. Zen Maru Gothic, a plain sans, excels at the opposite, a read that never snags on a closed-up bowl.
